purpose: Private cinematic camera/cast proposals, distinct from public travel pins. No site/game/Bible changes made. No invented geography. Recommended labels describe compositions, not newly named lore locations.

landscape.sampling: Original 4033x4033 registered one-metre height samples, bilinear within each cell; output cm. No guessed flat plane.

proposals.footprintTest: nine exact vertical rays across a 3.0m x 3.0m cast footprint; terrain-level obstacle slice does not apply to raised floor candidates; not gameplay collision/navmesh proof
proposals.bodyCheck: At each recommended actor center: source-supported floor (or exact landscape), plus 12 vertical rays on a 35cm radius ring reject geometry from12cm to200cm above that floor. Not a replacement for engine collision/navigation.
proposals.status: Source geometry candidate; browser/native visual composition and motion checks still required.
